title: Imbalance
coreMove: Detect the side of the system being overfed and deliberately support the human condition being crowded out.
sourcePressure: Names the crowding-out pattern where measurable order gains authority over less visible but essential human conditions like trust, discretion, and judgment.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Complaining that metrics are cold, or calling every workload problem imbalance.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary

exampleSpecs.audience: plant manager chasing perfect batch counts
exampleSpecs.stakes: output metric crowds out dough-rest judgment
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she slows one line after tasting the rushed crumb herself
